description: QC-019 Topological word: compare a presented Eisenstein pair (q, r) with the pair the law holds for a named word. word is one of the two words the law holds a pair for, Z2_a2b or Z2_abAB; any other word is REFUSED_WORD (not a group scan). q and r are the claimed integers. WIN when (q, r) equals the law's pair for that word, MISS otherwise; detail is the posted (q,r). Floats refused.
name: verify_topological_word
